observation.setting: Outdoor courtyard paved in a circle, in front of a modern one-story building with adobe-style architecture and wooden posts.
observation.dancers: Six dancers total: one drummer standing near the center, and five moving dancers (mixed men and women).
observation.formation_and_space: The five dancers move in a circular path around the courtyard plaza, following one another.
observation.posture: Upright torso with slightly bent knees and grounded weight.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping and hopping on bare feet in time with the percussion beats; exact micro-steps and rapid foot-changes are obscured by wide shots.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held near the body or extended, some dancers holding small rattles or shields; hands move naturally with the body's momentum.
observation.hips_and_torso: Hips and torso remain relatively upright and stable, moving in sync with the stepping rhythm.
observation.partnering: None; dancers move independently along the circular path.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low to medium level hops and occasional slight dips or turns while maintaining the circular path.
observation.costume_and_props: Elaborate feather headdresses (plumeros), beaded collars, colorful garments (green tunics, black cloaks with embroidered designs), seed rattle anklets (ayoyotes), and handheld rattles or shields; some wear face masks.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact acoustic details of vocal harmonies and rapid leg/ankle articulation due to distant camera angles and background noise.

signature_moments.what: Dancers hop rhythmically on one foot while traveling in a circle, their tall feather headdresses swaying.
